title: New y position
prompt: A jumping character has a vertical position y and a vertical speed vy in pixels per second (down is positive). Return the new y after one frame.
signature: func solve(y: float, vy: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(y: float, vy: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return y + vy
hint: The starter forgets delta, so it moves a whole second per frame. Scale the speed first.
solution:
func solve(y: float, vy: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return y + vy * delta
